fatal_failures: production or authored tests do not compile and run from a clean offline copy
no callable ExpandIssuance entry point is delivered
the implementation emits no genuine generated CDM 7.0.0 object at its output boundary
a tranche override mutates or leaks into a programme default or sibling output
a valid tap creates two output instruments with the same ISIN
a conflicting tap is silently accepted or handled with last-writer-wins
generated CDM source is edited or unrelated model fields are used to disguise missing issuance semantics

criteria.description: Resolve programme defaults independently for every tranche.
checks: The required three-row case produces GBP, EUR, GBP (or equivalent chosen currencies) in input order.
Issuer, governing-law, and currency overrides are resolved per row and do not leak to siblings.
Inputs and earlier outputs remain unchanged after later rows are processed.

criteria.description: Use the programme total as a fail-closed completeness check.
checks: The declared total is compared exactly with the sum of every input row, including tap rows.
A missing row or mismatched total yields an explicit failure and no misleading partial result.
The implementation does not invent FX conversion for the source-message checksum.

criteria.description: Consolidate a genuine fungible reopening without losing identity or provenance.
checks: A matching later row with the same ISIN produces one output identity and an exact summed issue size.
The result retains the original issue date and the later tap date or equivalent issuance provenance.
First-occurrence ordering is deterministic and a non-later duplicate is not silently merged.

criteria.description: Reject a duplicate ISIN when resolved fungibility terms conflict.
checks: A coupon conflict fails loudly rather than creating a duplicate or overwriting the original.
Maturity, currency, issuer, and governing-law conflicts are also considered after inheritance is resolved.
Decimal coupon comparison is numeric rather than accidentally scale-sensitive.

criteria.description: Choose and explain a faithful CDM 7.0.0 representation rather than following a prescribed topology.
checks: Outputs contain genuine generated CDM objects with a correctly typed ISIN security identity and issuer/LEI relationship where supported by the chosen topology.
The design distinguishes security-master identity from contractual/product economics and chooses Security, TransferableProduct/EconomicTerms, or an explicit application envelope for coherent reasons.

Coupon, maturity, currency, size, issue dates, governing law, and tap provenance each have an exact model path or are explicitly identified as application-owned/unrepresentable; no unrelated CDM field is repurposed.
The implementation uses version-correct generated builders, references, choices, and cardinalities and does not claim whole-object validity without evidence.

criteria.description: Expose predictable failures for malformed source data.
checks: Null structures, missing required terms, malformed ISIN/LEI values, non-positive sizes, invalid dates, and invalid rates are rejected or reported coherently.
Failures identify their reason and do not coexist with apparently successful partial instruments.
Validation policy is documented as application mapping policy versus generated CDM validation.

criteria.description: Deliver a reproducible, exact, mutation-safe implementation and meaningful tests.
checks: All four requested scenarios are asserted against caller-visible outputs, including the plausible wrong result.
BigDecimal is used without binary floating point for business values, result collections are stable, and mutable input collections cannot alias delivered results.
A clean offline Java 21/Gradle 8.10 build passes without ignored temp/cache dependencies, and DESIGN.md accurately describes the delivered code.
